cases.provenance: A user reported this defect after the reviewed pull request, and a later fix repaired it.
cases.summary: [Bug]: TextToDiagram modal autoscrolls page to bottom
cases.description:
In v0.18.0, when you click on the "Mermaid to Excalidraw" TTD modal button, the page autoscrolls to the bottom. You have to scroll back to where to modal was opened.

This is easily reproduced in the docs demo:
https://docs.excalidraw.com/docs/@excalidraw/excalidraw/api/children-components/main-menu

See attached video.

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/a10599a8-fad7-4c3b-b799-997dbc03d244

evidence.eventual_fix_title: fix: don't scroll page when TTDDialog is opened
evidence.eventual_fix_problem_statement:
fix: don't scroll page when TTDDialog is opened

fixes #9357 

Instead of using autoFocus on textarea in the TTDDialog, call focus() on textarea inside useEffect. This way we avoid focusing on textarea during initial rendering which was causing unwanted page scroll.
